claims.claim: The default release posture is releaseOn "started": the call returns once the worker is proven started and the background watcher takes over; "settle" is the opt-out; the default never applies to probes.
The worker's validated report file is the completion criterion, not the agent status; a report with status "fail" is still an honest completion.
A diagnosed retry after E_REPORT_MISSING/E_REPORT_INVALID must use a NEW worker name (e.g. <name>-r2) — the original name stays taken by the settled agent; at most 2 repeats, never verbatim.
A session cwd'd inside a worktree is a sub-orchestrator: worktree placement is rejected with E_PLACE; its children go through shared placement (tabs) only.
Probe workers never write a report file; a probe OK/FAIL result is final by itself — never wait for or read a probe's report-<name>.json.
After E_TIMEOUT or a detach, end your turn: the watcher wakes you on report-ready/question/death; never sleep in bash or re-call delegate to wait — delegate_status is the look-now alternative.

A brief's OUTPUT section carries acceptance criteria only; the tool's fixed prompt supplies the canonical worker name, report path and report contract — briefs stay name-agnostic and never paste report JSON.
